name: Weiler-Simmerberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Weiler-Simmerberg (a white wavy bend on red under a red house).
history: Municipal flag of Weiler-Simmerberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weiler-Simmerberg arms — wavy bend and house
